svg.text: Onboard U2 ISO7730: isolated IO3 output
Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
JP1/2/3 bridged; JP4 stays1–2 (3V3 isolated logic); JP5 stays1–2 (CS-gated return).
PB1/J1.3 → U2.3 input; U2.14 output → J2.3. Meter COM uses only J2.10 / GND_ISO.
Host5V → JP1 → FB1 → U1.9; U1.12/13 → FB4 → ISO_5V → U3 → ISO_3V3 → JP4 → U2.16.
Set PB1 digital LOW/HIGH; hold PG0/J1.6 HIGH to disable MISO buffer U6. Other host GPIO input-only.
Unused ISO input channels have source-documented default-HIGH outputs; no other isolated tool is connected.
Do not join HOST GND to GND_ISO. No isolation rating, external supply or load-current qualification.
J2.1/2 rails and J2.4–9 signals UNUSED; no extra supply or external load connected.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.
